activities.title: Welcome Back: What Is It Made Of?
activities.summary: Students bridge from Week 6 visual-description language into Week 7 fabric language by recognizing familiar look words and previewing material questions on one compact opener board.

en.title: Welcome Back: What Is It Made Of?
en.summary: Look at the images and choose the best fabric or material answer.
en.instructions: Look at the garments and swatches. Choose the correct answer for each short question about material, fabric, and one Week 6 review detail.
success_criteria: I can connect one visual clue to a fabric or material word.
I can remember one Week 6 visual word while I start Week 7.
I can notice that fabric description is the new focus this week.

pt.title: Bem-vindo de volta: de que é feito?
pt.summary: Observe as imagens e escolha a melhor resposta sobre tecido ou material.
pt.instructions: Observe as roupas e as amostras. Escolha a resposta correta para cada pergunta curta sobre material, tecido e um detalhe de revisão da Semana 6.
success_criteria: Eu consigo ligar uma pista visual a uma palavra de tecido ou material.
Eu consigo lembrar uma palavra visual da Semana 6 enquanto começo a Semana 7.
Eu consigo perceber que a descrição de tecido é o novo foco desta semana.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the opener light and fast. Students should feel that they are carrying Week 6 observation language into a new focus on materials, not starting a second full vocabulary lesson.

input.prompt_en: Choose the best review and preview answer for each image question.
input.prompt_pt: Escolha a melhor resposta de revisão e apresentação para cada pergunta sobre a imagem.

items.label_pt: Qual imagem parece denim?
O que significa fabric?

items.label_en: Complete the phrase: It is made ___ cotton.
items.label_pt: Complete a expressão: It is made ___ cotton.

items.label_en: Which Week 6 review word describes color, not fabric?
items.label_pt: Qual palavra de revisão da Semana 6 descreve cor, e não tecido?
Qual tecido parece brilhante?

steps.title: Look at the materials board
steps.student_action_en: Look at the garments and swatches and notice what looks familiar from Week 6.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe as roupas e as amostras e perceba o que parece familiar da Semana 6.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students that last week they described what a look looked like, and this week they begin describing what the material is like.

steps.title: Choose the short answers
steps.student_action_en: Choose the correct answer for each short review and preview question.
steps.student_action_pt: Escolha a resposta correta para cada pergunta curta de revisão e apresentação.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the pace supportive and quick so the opener feels like a bridge, not a test.

expected_output.description_en: Five quick recognition selections linking one opener board to fabric, material, and review language.
expected_output.description_pt: Cinco seleções rápidas de reconhecimento ligando um painel inicial à linguagem de tecido, material e revisão.

completion_criteria_en: The student identifies at least one material clue correctly.
The student uses one review item from Week 6 successfully.
The student notices that Week 7 focuses on fabric description.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno identifica corretamente pelo menos uma pista de material.
O aluno usa com sucesso um item de revisão da Semana 6.
O aluno percebe que a Semana 7 tem foco na descrição de tecidos.
checklist_en: I looked carefully at the images.
I used one review word from Week 6.
I noticed one new Week 7 material word.
checklist_pt: Eu observei as imagens com atenção.
Eu usei uma palavra de revisão da Semana 6.
Eu percebi uma nova palavra de material da Semana 7.
assessment.model_response_en: the blue jeans image, tecido, of, palette, and the silk-like fabric
assessment.model_response_pt: a imagem do jeans azul, tecido, of, palette e o tecido parecido com seda
common_errors: Choosing a Week 6 visual word when the question asks for a material.
Missing of in the phrase made of.
feedback_prompts_en: Look again. Which answer names the material and not only the color or style?
feedback_prompts_pt: Observe novamente. Qual resposta nomeia o material e não apenas a cor ou o estilo?

support: Let students quietly say the Portuguese support word before choosing the English-linked answer.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one full sentence such as It is made of denim.

extension_options: Say one more material word you already know without using the options.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as one image card with five short single-choice items. Save the selections only. Keep the experience quick and clearly positioned as a bridge from Week 6 visual language to Week 7 material language.

activities.title: Fabric Vocabulary: Common Materials
activities.summary: Students learn the core Week 7 material words by completing one main swatch-to-word matching set, then using a short Portuguese bridge and one use sentence as support.

en.title: Fabric Vocabulary: Common Materials
en.summary: Match the swatches and materials to the correct English words.
en.instructions: Match each visible key on the board to the correct English material word. After the main matching set, use the Portuguese support and one short sentence for extra practice.
success_criteria: I can match common fabrics and materials to English words.
I can use Portuguese support when I need it without losing the English target.
I can connect a fabric word to a garment use sentence.

pt.title: Vocabulário de tecido: materiais comuns
pt.summary: Relacione as amostras e os materiais às palavras corretas em inglês.
pt.instructions: Relacione cada chave visível do painel à palavra correta de material em inglês. Depois do conjunto principal de relação, use o apoio em português e uma frase curta para prática extra.
success_criteria: Eu consigo relacionar tecidos e materiais comuns a palavras em inglês.
Eu consigo usar apoio em português quando preciso sem perder o foco no inglês.
Eu consigo ligar uma palavra de tecido a uma frase sobre uso da roupa.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the main saved output focused on the image-to-word matching set. The Portuguese bridge and use sentence should come only after the main matching is complete.

input.prompt_en: Match the swatch keys to the correct English material words.
input.prompt_pt: Relacione as chaves das amostras às palavras corretas de material em inglês.

items.label_en: Match the board keys A to J to the correct material words from the answer inventory.
items.label_pt: Relacione as chaves A a J do painel às palavras corretas de material usando o inventário de respostas.

items.label_en: Match the Portuguese support to the English word.
items.label_pt: Relacione o apoio em português à palavra em inglês.
Complete a frase.

steps.title: Look at the board
steps.student_action_en: Look carefully at the common-materials board and notice the visible keys before you start matching.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe com atenção o painel de materiais comuns e perceba as chaves visíveis antes de começar a relacionar.
steps.teacher_action: Explain that the main task is swatch-to-word matching and that the support items come after the core matching set.

steps.title: Match the material words
steps.student_action_en: Match the visible keys on the board to the correct English material words.
steps.student_action_pt: Relacione as chaves visíveis do painel às palavras corretas de material em inglês.
steps.teacher_action: Monitor confusion points such as knit fabric versus woven fabric and lace versus leather.

steps.title: Use the support bridge
steps.student_action_en: Check a few Portuguese links and complete one short use sentence.
steps.student_action_pt: Confira algumas relações com o português e complete uma frase curta de uso.
steps.teacher_action: Use the bridge only as support after the main matching set is done.

expected_output.description_en: One saved image-word matching set as the main scored output, followed by short Portuguese bridge and fill-blank support.
expected_output.description_pt: Um conjunto salvo de relação imagem-palavra como resultado principal avaliado, seguido por apoio curto de ponte com o português e preenchimento de lacuna.
expected_output.length_or_format: 1 scored image-match set as the main saved output, plus follow-up support practice

completion_criteria_en: The student completes the main matching set.
The student connects common materials to English words.
The student may use the Portuguese bridge and fill-blank item after the main matching task.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno completa o conjunto principal de relação.
O aluno relaciona materiais comuns a palavras em inglês.
O aluno pode usar a ponte com o português e o item de lacuna depois da tarefa principal de relação.
checklist_en: I matched the main material images.
I checked the English words carefully.
I used the support items after the main task.
checklist_pt: Eu relacionei as imagens principais de materiais.
Eu conferi as palavras em inglês com atenção.
Eu usei os itens de apoio depois da tarefa principal.
assessment.model_response_en: A cotton, B denim, C linen, D silk, E wool, F polyester, G knit fabric, H woven fabric, I lace, J leather, and denim for the jacket sentence
assessment.model_response_pt: A algodão, B denim, C linho, D seda, E lã, F poliéster, G malha, H tecido plano, I renda, J couro, e denim para a frase da jaqueta
common_errors: Mixing knit fabric and woven fabric because both are fabric-construction words.
Confusing lace and leather by sound instead of by image.
feedback_prompts_en: Look again at the texture and surface. Which key shows a soft cloth and which key shows a stronger material?
feedback_prompts_pt: Observe novamente a textura e a superfície. Qual chave mostra um tecido macio e qual chave mostra um material mais forte?

support: Let students say the Portuguese support word quietly before choosing the English material word.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one extra sentence such as Linen is good for summer.

extension_options: Name one more garment that could be made of one of the materials on the board.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as one main keyed image-matching task with the board visible at all times. Save the matching set as the primary output. Show the Portuguese bridge and one fill-blank sentence only after the main matching is complete.

activities.title: Texture and Material Qualities
activities.summary: Students learn the core Week 7 fabric-quality words by completing one main quality-matching set, then using a short opposite pair and one support sentence after the main task.

en.title: Texture and Material Qualities
en.summary: Match the fabric qualities to the correct keyed images.
en.instructions: Match each visible key on the board to the correct English quality word. After the main matching set, use the short support items for extra practice.
success_criteria: I can match texture and surface words to clear fabric examples.
I can match movement, weight, and visibility words to clear fabric examples.
I can use one quality word in a short sentence.

pt.title: Textura e qualidades do material
pt.summary: Relacione as qualidades do tecido às imagens com chave correta.
pt.instructions: Relacione cada chave visível do painel à palavra correta de qualidade em inglês. Depois do conjunto principal de relação, use os itens curtos de apoio para prática extra.
success_criteria: Eu consigo relacionar palavras de textura e superfície a exemplos claros de tecido.
Eu consigo relacionar palavras de movimento, peso e visibilidade a exemplos claros de tecido.
Eu consigo usar uma palavra de qualidade em uma frase curta.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the main saved output focused on the quality-matching set. The support items should stay clearly secondary and should not replace the main matching path.

input.prompt_en: Match the board keys to the correct English quality words.
input.prompt_pt: Relacione as chaves do painel às palavras corretas de qualidade em inglês.

items.label_en: Match the board keys A to M to the correct quality words from the answer inventory.
items.label_pt: Relacione as chaves A a M do painel às palavras corretas de qualidade usando o inventário de respostas.

items.label_en: Which opposite pair matches the fabric qualities?
items.label_pt: Qual par de opostos combina com as qualidades do tecido?
Complete a frase.

steps.title: Look at the qualities board
steps.student_action_en: Look carefully at the board and notice the visible keys before you start matching.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe com atenção o painel e perceba as chaves visíveis antes de começar a relacionar.
steps.teacher_action: Explain that the main task is matching the visible examples to quality words and that the small support items come after the core matching.

steps.title: Match the quality words
steps.student_action_en: Match the visible keys on the board to the correct English quality words.
steps.student_action_pt: Relacione as chaves visíveis do painel às palavras corretas de qualidade em inglês.
steps.teacher_action: Monitor confusion points such as feels versus looks, flowy versus structured, and transparent versus opaque.

steps.title: Use the short support items
steps.student_action_en: Complete one opposite pair and one short sentence after the main matching set.
steps.student_action_pt: Complete um par de opostos e uma frase curta depois do conjunto principal de relação.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the support items clearly secondary to the main matching work.

expected_output.description_en: One saved image-word matching set for fabric qualities as the main scored output, followed by short support practice.
expected_output.description_pt: Um conjunto salvo de relação imagem-palavra para qualidades do tecido como resultado principal avaliado, seguido por prática curta de apoio.
expected_output.length_or_format: 1 scored image-match set as the main saved output, plus follow-up support practice

completion_criteria_en: The student completes the main quality-matching set.
The student connects visible fabric qualities to English words.
The student uses one short support item after the main task.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno completa o conjunto principal de relação de qualidades.
O aluno relaciona qualidades visíveis do tecido a palavras em inglês.
O aluno usa um item curto de apoio depois da tarefa principal.
checklist_en: I matched the main quality images.
I checked the English quality words carefully.
I used the support items after the main task.
checklist_pt: Eu relacionei as imagens principais de qualidades.
Eu conferi com atenção as palavras de qualidade em inglês.
Eu usei os itens de apoio depois da tarefa principal.
assessment.model_response_en: A soft, B rough, C smooth, D shiny, E matte, F lightweight, G heavy, H stretchy, I stiff, J flowy, K structured, L transparent, M opaque, with sheer for the lace sentence
assessment.model_response_pt: A macio, B áspero, C liso, D brilhante, E fosco, F leve, G pesado, H elástico, I rígido, J fluido, K estruturado, L transparente, M opaco, com sheer para a frase sobre renda

Mixing transparent and opaque because the image is not checked carefully.
feedback_prompts_en: Look again. Which quality is about touch, which is about appearance, and which is about visibility?
feedback_prompts_pt: Observe novamente. Qual qualidade fala do toque, qual fala da aparência e qual fala da visibilidade?

support: Let students point to the fabric example and say the Portuguese support word before matching the English answer.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one extra sentence such as The fabric feels soft and looks matte.

activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as one main keyed image-matching task with the board visible at all times. Save the matching set as the primary output. Show the opposite pair and one fill-blank support item only after the main matching is complete.

activities.title: Read: Fabric Swatch Descriptions
activities.summary: Students read three short A2 fabric descriptions and match them to the correct keyed swatches before answering detail questions about texture, appearance, and use.

en.title: Read: Fabric Swatch Descriptions
en.summary: Read the short fabric texts and choose the correct image or detail answer.
en.instructions: Read Text A, Text B, and Text C. Look at image A, image B, and image C. Choose the correct image or detail answer for each question.
success_criteria: I can match a short fabric description to the correct swatch.
I can find one important detail in a short text.
I can connect fabric words to texture and use.

pt.title: Leia: descrições de amostras de tecido
pt.summary: Leia os textos curtos sobre tecido e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto.
pt.instructions: Leia o Texto A, o Texto B e o Texto C. Observe a image A, a image B e a image C. Escolha a imagem ou a resposta de detalhe correta para cada pergunta.
success_criteria: Eu consigo relacionar uma descrição curta de tecido à amostra correta.
Eu consigo encontrar um detalhe importante em um texto curto.
Eu consigo ligar palavras de tecido à textura e ao uso.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the reading short and concrete. All detail questions must be answerable from the visible text and the visible keyed images.

input.prompt_en: Read the texts and choose the correct image or detail answer.
input.prompt_pt: Leia os textos e escolha a imagem ou a resposta de detalhe correta.

items.label_pt: Texto A
items.reading_text_en: This is a cotton fabric swatch. It is white and lightweight. It feels soft and smooth. It is good for shirts and summer dresses.
items.reading_text_pt: Este é um texto em inglês sobre uma amostra de algodão. Leia o texto em inglês para responder.

items.label_pt: Texto B
items.reading_text_en: This is denim. It is blue, heavy, and structured. It feels thick and strong. It is good for jeans and jackets.
items.reading_text_pt: Este é um texto em inglês sobre denim. Leia o texto em inglês para responder.

items.label_pt: Texto C
items.reading_text_en: This is lace. It is black and textured. It looks sheer and decorative. It can be used for sleeves, details, or accessories.
items.reading_text_pt: Este é um texto em inglês sobre renda. Leia o texto em inglês para responder.

items.label_pt: Qual imagem combina com o Texto A?

items.label_en: Which fabric is heavy and structured?
items.label_pt: Qual tecido é pesado e estruturado?

items.label_en: Cotton is good for shirts and summer dresses.
items.label_pt: Cotton é bom para camisas e vestidos de verão.
Qual é a cor da renda?
Sheer significa ...

steps.title: Read the three short texts
steps.student_action_en: Read Text A, Text B, and Text C once before answering.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia o Texto A, o Texto B e o Texto C uma vez antes de responder.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students to look for color, feel, and use clues in each text.

steps.title: Match the text to the swatch
steps.student_action_en: Look at image A, image B, and image C and choose the correct image answer.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a image A, a image B e a image C e escolha a resposta correta de imagem.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the visible image keys on screen while students answer.

steps.title: Answer the detail questions
steps.student_action_en: Answer the final detail questions about weight, color, and meaning.
steps.student_action_pt: Responda às perguntas finais de detalhe sobre peso, cor e significado.
steps.teacher_action: Point students back to the exact sentence in the text when needed.

expected_output.description_en: Five app-checked reading selections linked to three short texts and one keyed swatch gallery.
expected_output.description_pt: Cinco seleções de leitura verificadas pelo app ligadas a três textos curtos e a uma galeria de amostras com chave.

completion_criteria_en: The student matches the reading text to the correct swatch.
The student answers the detail questions accurately.
The student uses text evidence rather than guessing from one word only.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno relaciona o texto de leitura à amostra correta.
O aluno responde às perguntas de detalhe com precisão.
O aluno usa evidência do texto em vez de adivinhar por uma palavra apenas.
checklist_en: I read the three texts first.
I used the image keys carefully.
I checked the detail words in the text.
checklist_pt: Eu li os três textos primeiro.
Eu usei as chaves das imagens com atenção.
Eu conferi as palavras de detalhe no texto.
assessment.model_response_en: image A, denim, true, black, and transparent
assessment.model_response_pt: image A, denim, verdadeiro, preto e transparente
common_errors: Choosing by one color word only and missing the fabric-use clue.
Confusing transparent and decorative because both appear in the lace text.
feedback_prompts_en: Read the sentence again. Which word tells you the color, weight, or use clearly?
feedback_prompts_pt: Leia a frase novamente. Qual palavra mostra com clareza a cor, o peso ou o uso?

support: Let students underline one clue word in each text before answering the questions.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one extra sentence about why the text matches the image.

extension_options: Find one more adjective in the texts and say whether it is about feel or appearance.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as three visible short texts plus a keyed image gallery with image A-C visible at all times. Save selection answers only. Keep the text, image keys, question wording, and correct answers fully aligned.

activities.title: Listen: Which Fabric Is It?
activities.summary: Students listen to four short spoken fabric descriptions and identify the correct swatch or key detail using the shared four-swatch gallery.

en.title: Listen: Which Fabric Is It?
en.summary: Listen to the four fabric descriptions and choose the correct image or detail answer.
en.instructions: Look at image A, image B, image C, and image D. Listen to the audio and choose the correct image or detail answer for each question.
success_criteria: I can identify a fabric from a short audio description.
I can hear words about feel, look, and use in context.
I can connect numbered audio information to the correct image key.

pt.title: Escute: qual tecido é esse?
pt.summary: Escute as quatro descrições de tecido e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto.
pt.instructions: Observe a image A, a image B, a image C e a image D. Escute o áudio e escolha a imagem ou a resposta de detalhe correta para cada pergunta.
success_criteria: Eu consigo identificar um tecido a partir de uma descrição curta em áudio.
Eu consigo ouvir palavras sobre toque, aparência e uso em contexto.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the audio and image keys fully aligned. Do not add any question that asks for information not stated clearly in the script.

input.prompt_en: Listen to the four descriptions and choose the correct image or detail answer.
input.prompt_pt: Escute as quatro descrições e escolha a imagem ou a resposta de detalhe correta.

items.label_pt: Qual imagem é o Número Um?
Qual imagem é o Número Dois?

items.label_en: Which image is shiny and smooth?
items.label_pt: Qual imagem é brilhante e lisa?

items.label_en: Number Four looks sheer and decorative.
items.label_pt: O Número Quatro parece transparente e decorativo.

items.label_en: Which fabric is good for jeans and jackets?

steps.title: Look at the gallery first
steps.student_action_en: Look at image A, image B, image C, and image D before playing the audio.

steps.teacher_action: Keep the focus on what the audio says clearly rather than on guessing from style alone.

expected_output.description_en: Five app-checked listening selections linked to one audio clip and the four-swatch image gallery.

completion_criteria_en: The student uses the numbered audio descriptions to identify the correct fabrics.
The student answers the detail questions accurately.
The student connects audio details to the visible image keys.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno usa as descrições numeradas do áudio para identificar os tecidos corretos.

checklist_en: I looked at the gallery before listening.
I used the image keys while listening.
I checked the detail questions carefully.
checklist_pt: Eu observei a galeria antes de escutar.
Eu usei as chaves das imagens enquanto escutava.
Eu conferi as perguntas de detalhe com atenção.

assessment.model_response_pt: Número Um image A, Número Dois image B, brilhante e lisa image C, Número Quatro verdadeiro e denim para jeans e jaquetas

feedback_prompts_pt: Escute novamente. Quais palavras mostram o toque, a aparência ou o uso do tecido?

activities.title: Phrase Practice: Made Of / Feels / Looks / Good For
activities.summary: Students practice the main Week 7 description frames through short fill-blank items, with one small support review item after the main phrase-completion work.

en.title: Phrase Practice: Made Of / Feels / Looks / Good For
en.summary: Complete the fabric phrases with the correct word or short phrase.
en.instructions: Complete each short sentence with the correct word or phrase. Focus on made of, feels, looks, and good for.
success_criteria: I can complete short fabric-description phrases correctly.
I can choose feels for touch and looks for appearance.
I can connect one fabric to one garment use.

pt.title: Prática de frases: made of / feels / looks / good for
pt.summary: Complete as frases sobre tecido com a palavra ou expressão correta.
pt.instructions: Complete cada frase curta com a palavra ou expressão correta. Foque em made of, feels, looks e good for.
success_criteria: Eu consigo completar corretamente frases curtas de descrição de tecido.
Eu consigo escolher feels para toque e looks para aparência.
Eu consigo ligar um tecido a um uso de roupa.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the main saved output focused on fill-blank phrase completion. Any extra choice or correction item should stay clearly secondary and framed as support or review.

input.prompt_pt: Complete as frases de descrição de tecido da Semana 7.

items.label_pt: The jacket is made of ___.
The fabric feels ___.
The fabric looks ___.
This fabric is ___.
Lace can be used for ___.
Cotton is good for ___.
Denim is ___.
Qual frase está correta?
options_en: It feels shiny for the eyes.

steps.title: Read the phrase frames
steps.student_action_en: Read the Week 7 phrase frames before you start filling the blanks.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia as frases-modelo da Semana 7 antes de começar a preencher as lacunas.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students that the main goal is phrase completion, not long writing.

steps.title: Complete the main phrase set

activities.title: Fabric Swatch Description Card
activities.summary: Students produce the main Week 7 artifact by choosing one swatch and completing a short structured description card with 6 required sentence-frame lines and 1 optional challenge line.

en.title: Fabric Swatch Description Card
en.summary: Choose one swatch and complete a short description card in English.
en.instructions: Choose one swatch from images A to D. Complete the 6 required sentence-frame lines about the fabric name, color, feel, look, behavior, and use. Add the challenge line only if you want extra practice.
success_criteria: I can complete the required description lines.
I can use fabric, feel, look, and use language in short English sentences.
I can revise one sentence after teacher feedback.
sentence_frames: Line 1: This is ___. / This is a ___ fabric swatch.
Line 6: It is good for ___. / It can be used for ___.
Optional challenge: I like this fabric because ___.

pt.title: Cartão de descrição da amostra de tecido
pt.summary: Escolha uma amostra e complete um cartão curto de descrição em inglês.
pt.instructions: Escolha uma amostra das imagens A até D. Complete as 6 linhas obrigatórias com frases-modelo sobre o nome do tecido, a cor, o toque, a aparência, o comportamento e o uso. Acrescente a linha de desafio apenas se você quiser prática extra.
success_criteria: Eu consigo completar as linhas obrigatórias de descrição.
Eu consigo usar linguagem de tecido, toque, aparência e uso em frases curtas em inglês.
Eu consigo revisar uma frase depois do feedback do professor.
sentence_frames: Linha 1: This is ___. / This is a ___ fabric swatch.
Linha 6: It is good for ___. / It can be used for ___.
Desafio opcional: I like this fabric because ___.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the task structured and line-based. Do not turn it into a paragraph or a word-count task. Students should complete 6 required lines plus 1 optional challenge line only if ready.

input.prompt_en: Choose one swatch from images A to D and complete the required description lines.
input.prompt_pt: Escolha uma amostra das imagens A até D e complete as linhas obrigatórias de descrição.

items.label_pt: Escolha a imagem da sua amostra.

items.label_en: Line 1: Name the fabric or swatch.
items.label_pt: Linha 1: Nomeie o tecido ou a amostra.
items.sentence_frame_en: This is ___. / This is a ___ fabric swatch.
items.sentence_frame_pt: This is ___. / This is a ___ fabric swatch.

items.label_en: Line 2: Add one color or first visible quality.
items.label_pt: Linha 2: Acrescente uma cor ou primeira qualidade visível.
Linha 3: Descreva o toque.
Linha 4: Descreva a aparência.

items.label_en: Line 5: Describe the behavior or structure.
items.label_pt: Linha 5: Descreva o comportamento ou a estrutura.
Linha 6: Descreva o uso.
items.sentence_frame_en: It is good for ___. / It can be used for ___.
items.sentence_frame_pt: It is good for ___. / It can be used for ___.

items.label_pt: Linha de desafio opcional

steps.title: Choose one swatch
steps.student_action_en: Look at images A to D and choose one swatch to describe.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe as imagens A até D e escolha uma amostra para descrever.
steps.teacher_action: Guide students toward a swatch that matches their confidence level.

steps.title: Complete the required lines
steps.student_action_en: Complete the required sentence-frame lines about the fabric name, color, feel, look, behavior, and use.
steps.student_action_pt: Complete as linhas obrigatórias com frases-modelo sobre o nome do tecido, a cor, o toque, a aparência, o comportamento e o uso.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the writing structured. Encourage students to finish one line at a time.

steps.title: Add the optional challenge only if ready
steps.student_action_en: Add the challenge line only if you want extra practice.
steps.student_action_pt: Acrescente a linha de desafio apenas se você quiser prática extra.
steps.teacher_action: Make it clear that the challenge line is optional, not required.

steps.title: Check and submit
steps.student_action_en: Read your lines again and submit the card for teacher review.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia suas linhas novamente e envie o cartão para revisão do professor.
steps.teacher_action: Prompt students to check made of, feels, and looks before submission when relevant.

expected_output.description_en: A saved Fabric Swatch Description Card with 6 required sentence-frame lines and 1 optional challenge line.
expected_output.description_pt: Um Cartão de Descrição da Amostra de Tecido salvo com 6 linhas obrigatórias de frases-modelo e 1 linha de desafio opcional.
expected_output.length_or_format: 6 required lines plus 1 optional challenge line

completion_criteria_en: The student completes the required description lines.
The student uses fabric, feel, look, and use language clearly.
The optional challenge line may be added, but it is not required.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno completa as linhas obrigatórias de descrição.
O aluno usa com clareza linguagem de tecido, toque, aparência e uso.
A linha de desafio opcional pode ser acrescentada, mas não é obrigatória.
checklist_en: The card names the fabric or swatch clearly.
The card includes one feel sentence.
The card includes one look sentence.
The card includes one behavior or structure sentence.
The card includes one use sentence.
The challenge line is optional only.
checklist_pt: O cartão nomeia com clareza o tecido ou a amostra.
O cartão inclui uma frase sobre o toque.
O cartão inclui uma frase sobre a aparência.
O cartão inclui uma frase sobre comportamento ou estrutura.
O cartão inclui uma frase sobre uso.
A linha de desafio é apenas opcional.
assessment.model_response_en: This is a cotton fabric swatch. It is white. It feels soft. It looks smooth. It is lightweight. It is good for shirts and summer dresses. Optional challenge: I like this fabric because it is comfortable.
assessment.model_response_pt: Esta é uma amostra de algodão. Ela é branca. Parece macia ao toque. Parece lisa. Ela é leve. É boa para camisas e vestidos de verão. Desafio opcional: Eu gosto deste tecido porque ele é confortável.
common_errors: Writing a list of words instead of complete sentence-frame lines.
Using feels for appearance or looks for touch.
Leaving out of when trying to use made of in a garment sentence.
Treating the optional challenge line like a required line.
feedback_prompts_en: Please complete one line as a full sentence.
Please check whether this idea should use feels or looks.
Please add one clearer use sentence.
Please revise one line and submit again.
feedback_prompts_pt: Por favor, complete uma linha como frase inteira.
Por favor, confira se esta ideia deve usar feels ou looks.
Por favor, acrescente uma frase mais clara sobre o uso.
Por favor, revise uma linha e envie novamente.

support: Let students complete exactly six core lines with a visible word bank and one model line on screen.
challenge: Invite stronger learners to add the optional challenge line with a clear reason linked to comfort, garment type, or season.

extension_options: Turn one line from the card into a speaking note for the teacher session.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as a teacher-reviewed structured writing card with separate saved line fields, not a paragraph text box. Keep 6 lines required, 1 challenge line optional, and show the teacher the checklist, common errors, feedback prompts, and return-for-revision workflow.

activities.title: Review and Improve: Fabric Phrases and Adjectives
activities.summary: Students review one narrow Week 7 sentence problem and save one corrected fabric-description sentence they can transfer back into the writing card.

en.title: Review and Improve: Fabric Phrases and Adjectives
en.summary: Choose one correction card and write the improved sentence.
en.instructions: Choose one correction card, notice the problem, and write the corrected sentence clearly.
success_criteria: I can notice one common Week 7 sentence problem.
I can write one corrected sentence clearly.
I can use the correction to improve my own fabric description.

pt.title: Revise e melhore: frases e adjetivos sobre tecido
pt.summary: Escolha um cartão de correção e escreva a frase melhorada.
pt.instructions: Escolha um cartão de correção, perceba o problema e escreva a frase corrigida com clareza.
success_criteria: Eu consigo perceber um problema comum de frase da Semana 7.
Eu consigo escrever uma frase corrigida com clareza.
Eu consigo usar a correção para melhorar minha própria descrição de tecido.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep one narrow correction target per card. The goal is transfer back into the Week 7 fabric-description card, not broad grammar explanation.

input.prompt_en: Choose one Week 7 sentence and write the corrected version.
input.prompt_pt: Escolha uma frase da Semana 7 e escreva a versão corrigida.

items.label_pt: Corrija a frase com made of.
Corrija a frase sobre o toque.
Corrija a frase sobre a aparência.
Corrija a frase sobre o uso.

steps.title: Choose a correction card
steps.student_action_en: Read the four Week 7 correction cards and choose one sentence to fix.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia os quatro cartões de correção da Semana 7 e escolha uma frase para corrigir.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students to choose one card only so the task stays quick and focused.

steps.title: Write the corrected sentence
steps.student_action_en: Write the improved sentence clearly.
steps.student_action_pt: Escreva a frase melhorada com clareza.
steps.teacher_action: Prompt students to check made of, feels, looks, and good for carefully.

steps.title: Transfer the correction
steps.student_action_en: Check whether the same problem appears in your writing card.
steps.student_action_pt: Verifique se o mesmo problema aparece no seu cartão de escrita.
steps.teacher_action: Link the correction task back to the Week 7 writing card before the speaking session.

expected_output.description_en: One corrected Week 7 sentence saved after review.
expected_output.description_pt: Uma frase corrigida da Semana 7 salva após a revisão.

completion_criteria_en: The student chooses one card and writes a corrected sentence.
The corrected sentence matches an accepted answer.
The student checks for the same problem in the writing card.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno escolhe um cartão e escreve uma frase corrigida.
A frase corrigida corresponde a uma resposta aceita.
O aluno verifica o mesmo problema no cartão de escrita.
checklist_en: I chose one correction card.
I wrote one corrected sentence.
I checked my Week 7 writing card.
checklist_pt: Eu escolhi um cartão de correção.
Eu escrevi uma frase corrigida.
Eu conferi o meu cartão de escrita da Semana 7.
common_errors: Keeping the same sentence problem and changing only one word.
Using feels for visual qualities or looks for touch.
Forgetting for after good.
feedback_prompts_en: Please check the full phrase again.
Please choose feels or looks more carefully.
Please compare your answer with the model phrase.
feedback_prompts_pt: Por favor, confira a frase completa novamente.
Por favor, escolha feels ou looks com mais cuidado.
Por favor, compare a sua resposta com a frase-modelo.

support: Let students say the corrected sentence quietly before typing it.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to explain why the original sentence is incorrect.

extension_options: Rewrite one line from the writing card after checking the correction.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as one small correction-card activity. Let the student choose one card, type the corrected version, and compare against accepted answers. Save one corrected sentence as the mini-revision artifact.

activities.title: Teacher Session: Describe a Fabric
activities.summary: Students use their Week 7 writing card to practice pronunciation, identify key fabric qualities, and describe one swatch in short supported sentences.

en.title: Teacher Session: Describe a Fabric
en.summary: Use your card to describe one fabric in short sentences.
en.instructions: Bring your Fabric Swatch Description Card, practice the key words, and describe one swatch in 4 to 6 short sentences.
success_criteria: I can name one fabric clearly.
I can use feel, look, and use language while speaking.
I can give one short reason sentence with teacher support.

pt.title: Sessão com o professor: descreva um tecido
pt.summary: Use o seu cartão para descrever um tecido em frases curtas.
pt.instructions: Leve o seu Cartão de Descrição da Amostra de Tecido, pratique as palavras principais e descreva uma amostra em 4 a 6 frases curtas.
success_criteria: Eu consigo nomear um tecido com clareza.
Eu consigo usar linguagem de toque, aparência e uso ao falar.
Eu consigo dar uma frase curta de justificativa com apoio do professor.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep this teacher-observed only. Do not record student audio. Focus on intelligibility, accurate Week 7 sentence frames, and confidence with a short supported fabric description rather than on long performance.

input.prompt_en: Use your Week 7 writing card to describe one fabric in short sentences.
input.prompt_pt: Use o seu cartão de escrita da Semana 7 para descrever um tecido em frases curtas.

items.label_en: Say 4 to 6 short sentences about one fabric swatch.
items.label_pt: Diga de 4 a 6 frases curtas sobre uma amostra de tecido.

items.label_en: Include the fabric name, one feel detail, one look detail, and one use detail.
items.label_pt: Inclua o nome do tecido, um detalhe de toque, um detalhe de aparência e um detalhe de uso.

steps.title: Pronunciation clinic
steps.student_action_en: Practice key Week 7 words such as fabric, swatch, cotton, denim, silk, lace, lightweight, structured, and opaque.
steps.student_action_pt: Pratique palavras importantes da Semana 7 como fabric, swatch, cotton, denim, silk, lace, lightweight, structured e opaque.
steps.teacher_action: Model the words slowly and clearly, especially swatch, cotton, denim, lightweight, structured, transparent, and opaque.

steps.title: Warm up with the swatches
steps.student_action_en: Look at the shared gallery and say one quality word for each image.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a galeria compartilhada e diga uma palavra de qualidade para cada imagem.
steps.teacher_action: Use quick pointing and naming before the full speaking turn.

steps.title: Describe one fabric
steps.student_action_en: Use your Week 7 card to describe one fabric in 4 to 6 short sentences.
steps.student_action_pt: Use o seu cartão da Semana 7 para descrever um tecido em 4 a 6 frases curtas.
steps.teacher_action: Allow students to read from their card first, then invite a more natural second try when appropriate.

steps.title: Wrap up and preview
steps.student_action_en: Listen to classmates and prepare for next week’s work with garment construction and sewing actions.
steps.student_action_pt: Escute os colegas e prepare-se para o trabalho da próxima semana com construção de peças e ações de costura.
steps.teacher_action: Close with one short review of feels, looks, and good for.

expected_output.description_en: A short teacher-observed spoken description of one fabric using Week 7 sentence frames.
expected_output.description_pt: Uma descrição oral curta, observada pelo professor, de um tecido usando as estruturas da Semana 7.

completion_criteria_en: The student names one chosen fabric clearly.
The student uses feel, look, and use language in short sentences.
The student adds at least one clear reason or function detail with support if needed.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno nomeia com clareza um tecido escolhido.
O aluno usa linguagem de toque, aparência e uso em frases curtas.
O aluno acrescenta pelo menos uma justificativa clara ou um detalhe de função com apoio, se necessário.
checklist_en: I practiced the Week 7 words.
I used my description card.
I described one fabric in short sentences.
checklist_pt: Eu pratiquei as palavras da Semana 7.
Eu usei o meu cartão de descrição.
Eu descrevi um tecido em frases curtas.
assessment.model_response_en: This is a silk fabric swatch. It feels smooth. It looks shiny. It is lightweight. It is good for elegant blouses. I like this fabric because it looks beautiful.
assessment.model_response_pt: Esta é uma amostra de seda. Ela parece lisa ao toque. Ela parece brilhante. Ela é leve. É boa para blusas elegantes. Eu gosto deste tecido porque ele parece bonito.
common_errors: Saying fabric names only and skipping the full sentence frames.
Using feels for visual qualities or looks for touch.
Speaking too quietly to be understood.
feedback_prompts_en: Can you add one feel sentence?
Can you say that again with looks or feels in the best place?
Can you add one use sentence?
feedback_prompts_pt: Você pode acrescentar uma frase sobre o toque?
Você pode dizer novamente com looks ou feels no melhor lugar?
Você pode acrescentar uma frase sobre o uso?

support: Allow students to read directly from the writing card in the first round.
challenge: Ask stronger learners one follow-up question about weather, comfort, or garment type.

extension_options: Add one extra spoken sentence comparing two swatches from the gallery.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Keep this as a teacher-observed speaking checkpoint with the shared swatch gallery and the saved Week 7 writing card visible on screen. Do not record or upload student audio. The app role is to display prompts, link to the writing artifact, and store teacher completion notes only.
